verdict.rationale: Skills are fully programmable. A first-party Skills API uploads and manages custom skills, with a Skill Versions API for version management. Skills attach to Messages API requests via the `container` parameter (up to 20 per request, including pre-built pptx/xlsx/docx/pdf). The Agent SDK lets you control which skills sessions can invoke, dispatch commands by name, and load plugins programmatically, mirroring the Claude Code UI flows. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of API/UI parity (e.g., whether skills uploaded in Claude.ai and via the API are shared or managed identically), programmatic equivalents of plugin-marketplace install (the SDK loads plugins from local directories), and independent hands-on corroboration.
